name: Uber Hostage ID
hook: Hold a stranger's dropped German ID hostage for escalating ransom euros
tagline: Dangle a lost laminated driver's license out of an Uber backseat window while demanding higher wire transfers from panicking tourists. Cashing out hands the card back smoothly for a fat stack of euros. Crashing triggers a swift German Bundespolizei tackle that smashes the ID into shreds.
